definitions.explanation: The quality of being sticky or adhering to surfaces, or the tendency to cling.

examples.japanese: {粘着性|ねんちゃくせい}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦ある→ある：00006_aru⟧⟦テープ→テープ：01535_teepu⟧。
⟦この→この：00962_kono⟧⟦{素材|そざい}→素材：09492_sozai⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{粘着性|ねんちゃくせい}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{高|たか}い→高い：00500_takai⟧。

⟦{温度|おんど}→温度：00333_ondo⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{上|あ}がる→上がる：00615_agaru⟧⟦と→と：00512_to⟧{粘着性|ねんちゃくせい}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{低下|ていか}→低下：04065_teika⟧⟦して→する：00392_suru⟧、⟦テープ→テープ：01535_teepu⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{剥|は}がれ→剥がれる：04363_hagareru⟧やすく⟦なる→なる：01970_naru⟧。
examples.english: When the temperature rises, the adhesiveness decreases and the tape becomes easier to peel off.

notes:
A compound of ⟦{粘着|ねんちゃく}→粘着：15074_nenchaku⟧ (adhesion, sticking) and ⟦{性|せい}→性：09880_sei⟧ (quality, property). Used in technical, manufacturing, and everyday contexts to describe the sticky quality of materials like tape, glue, and coatings.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {粘着性|ねんちゃくせい}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{高|たか}い→高い：00500_takai⟧: highly adhesive
- {粘着性|ねんちゃくせい}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{低|ひく}い→低い：02947_hikui⟧: low adhesiveness
- {粘着性|ねんちゃくせい}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦ある→ある：00006_aru⟧: having adhesiveness; sticky
- {粘着性|ねんちゃくせい}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{持|も}つ→持つ：00478_motsu⟧: to have adhesiveness

SIMILAR WORDS:
- {粘着力|ねんちゃくりょく}: adhesive strength — focuses on the measurable force of adhesion
- {粘性|ねんせい}: viscosity — the resistance of a fluid to flow
- {接着性|せっちゃくせい}: adhesion; bonding quality — the ability to bond two surfaces together
